name: Co Researcher
headline: co-researcher plugins for coding tools
short_description: A professional research suite with specialized agents for conducting rigorous academic research. Compatible with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, and OpenCode.
author: poemswe

sections.overview:
Co-Researcher is a professional research suite that automates academic research workflows using specialized PhD-level agents. It provides intelligent orchestration across literature review, critical analysis, quantitative analysis, and hypothesis testing—coordinating multi-agent workflows to produce rigorous, integrated research findings. The tool includes 16 specialized skills governed by Systemic Honesty principles, covering systematic reviews, ethics compliance, grant writing, and research synthesis. Compatible with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, and OpenCode, it supports interactive, automated, and plan-only execution modes with pre-configured templates for quick, rigorous, or comprehensive research approaches.
Conducting systematic literature reviews with automated methodology validation
Academic research project planning with multi-agent orchestration
Grant proposal development with funding strategy guidance
Critical analysis of research studies for bias and methodological flaws
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/poemswe/co-researcher`
sections.usage:
```
Act as my co-researcher. I'm investigating [TOPIC] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Provide a structured research outline including key questions, potential sources, and analysis methods. Focus on [SPECIFIC ASPECT] of the topic.
```
Copy

```
# Research Outline: Sustainable Packaging in the Food Industry
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
